public_rationale: Anthropic's filing supplies material evidence of improvement, including Q2 operating profit. The customer reporting also documents continuing resistance to rising bills. Neither establishes the sustained reversal required here, and continued difficulties cannot prove an unlimited prediction. No decisive event settles the forecast by October 28.
limitations: The persistence threshold is an evaluator interpretation.
Operating profit, net profit, and cash generation are distinct.
Reported customer examples do not measure the entire customer base.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI and Anthropic cannot reverse the trend of high costs and price-sensitive customers.

statement.excerpt: There is no reversing this trend, because if there were, OpenAI and Anthropic would’ve reversed it in any way, shape or form, rather than raising more money than anyone has ever raised before for what appears to be no reason other than to burn it.

from_speaker: There is no reversing this trend
our_interpretation: The trend refers to the preceding discussion of costs exceeding customer payments and resistance to higher effective prices.
The plain reading is a prediction that neither company can achieve a durable reversal of those economics.

For an early contradiction, I require at least two consecutive comparable quarters of full operating-cost coverage, including training, with continued customer purchases at those prices. The two-quarter persistence test is my operational choice.
A reversal at either named company would refute the categorical claim about both.
Fundraising is part of his explanation, not a forecast condition. I do not grade the separate superlative about fundraising records.
No deadline or accounting basis is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: The unlimited negative forecast cannot be established by a finite stretch of losses. Terminal failure of both businesses without a sustained reversal could settle its business-history reading.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Either company demonstrates sustained full-cost operating profitability and continued customer purchases on comparable terms, meeting the stated persistence test.
